name: Ants: herding against colony size
description: Alfarano and Milaković's N-dependence: the variance of the share against the number of ants, 500 meetings (Kirman) or one sweep (Alfarano and Milaković) a step, 20 000 steps. Kirman's rule at Figure IIb's ε and δ, with anyone meeting anyone or on a random network (link probability 0.1), and Alfarano and Milaković's (a 0.5, λ 1) on a ring of degree 10 and on the random network. Measured (release, seeds 1–3, recorded 2026-09-27): Kirman 0.208, 0.179, 0.137, 0.078, 0.040 at N 50, 100, 200, 500, 1 000 (on the random network 0.207 … 0.054) — the herding fades; Alfarano and Milaković on the ring 0.038, 0.020, 0.009, 0.003, 0.002 (their mean field 0.042 … 0.0025); on the random network 0.022, 0.021, 0.022, 0.020, 0.018, flat, as they say (mean field 0.023). A random network cures N-dependence under their rule, where each ant hears all its neighbors, and not under Kirman's, where a meeting is one partner.
